title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — November 19, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B7.0 (Peaked November 19, 2026 at 22:55 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 399 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)

Things are pretty quiet. ☀️

Several active regions and a clear sunspot are visible on today’s solar disk, with no obvious large outward coronal structure in the coronagraph.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 284 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
